page.notes: Marginal numbers 10 to 60 stand in the gutter between the columns; they are line numbers and are given as notes. Several names and place names are doubtful and may be misprinted: "Vuillebrochij", "Vuillingi", "Vuiteberg", "Francofa", "Chytreo", "Quecum", "Mansfelden". Some letters in the bottom lines are uncertain. The left column's paragraph breaks follow the printed "*" entries. The "Ioannes" at the bottom right is treated as the catchword. The right column's "1568" entry is a new entry and does not continue the left column's last line.
